landing.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
landing.faq.q1.a: GA Lite is a multi-site analytics dashboard for Google Analytics, Search Console and Bing Webmaster. Connect your accounts, see traffic and search performance on one screen, share selected dashboards, and let AI read the same data through MCP.
landing.faq.q2.q: Does GA Lite work with Google Search Console?
landing.faq.q2.a: Yes. Alongside Google Analytics (GA4), GA Lite connects Search Console and Bing Webmaster, then shows clicks, impressions, CTR, average position and top queries next to your traffic data.
landing.faq.q3.q: How is GA Lite different from opening Google Analytics directly?
landing.faq.q3.a: Google Analytics shows one property at a time. GA Lite aggregates GA4 properties, Search Console sites and Bing Webmaster sites across accounts into one portfolio view, and exposes the same data to Claude, Cursor and other AI clients through MCP.
landing.faq.q4.q: Can I connect multiple Google Analytics accounts?
landing.faq.q4.a: Yes. Sign in with as many Google accounts as you need; GA Lite imports every GA4 property and Search Console site you can access, and you can add Bing Webmaster with an API key.
landing.faq.q5.q: What is the difference between the self-hosted edition and galite.io?
landing.faq.q5.a: This edition runs in your own Cloudflare account and stores settings, encrypted credentials, and caches in your D1 database. galite.io is the ready-to-use online version for people who do not want to deploy or maintain an instance.
landing.faq.q6.a: Yes, your analytics data is safe. GA Lite reads the numbers needed for your dashboard and cached reports. You can disconnect providers anytime, and public sharing only uses the visibility settings you choose.
landing.faq.q7.q: Can AI read my analytics through GA Lite?
landing.faq.q7.a: Yes. Add GA Lite’s MCP endpoint to any MCP-aware client — Claude Code, Cursor, Cline, Perplexity, Gemini and more — approve access once in the browser, and your AI can read your analytics directly.
landing.faq.q8.q: Can I share my analytics publicly?
landing.faq.q8.a: Yes. A public profile can show social account links and public basic site data; you can also use anonymous mode to hide site identity or protect a specific site with a password.
landing.faq.q9.a: GA Lite uses the page and event data already available in your connected GA4 property. Each funnel card supports 2–5 funnel steps.
landing.faq.q10.q: Does it work with Bing Webmaster Tools?
landing.faq.q10.a: Yes. Add your Bing Webmaster API key and GA Lite syncs those sites, then shows Bing search data beside Google Search Console data.
landing.faq.q11.q: Does GA Lite store my analytics or search data?
landing.faq.q11.a: GA Lite does not store your site analytics or search performance data long term. Some features temporarily cache aggregated results for up to 24 hours.
landing.final.title: Connect your traffic, search, sharing and AI workflow with GA Lite in under 60 seconds
landing.final.subtitle: Your dashboard, credentials, and cached data stay in your own Cloudflare account.
about.meta.description: Why we built GA Lite: GA was a great database with a dashboard that hid what mattered.
about.hero.title: We built the dashboard GA never gave us.
about.body.p1: We've shipped products and stared at GA4 every Monday. Switched accounts ten times before noon. We know the routine.
about.body.p2: The truth is, GA4 is a great database. But its dashboard hides what matters — buried under tabs, properties, and dimensions you have to remember each time.
about.body.p3: You can't see your whole portfolio at a glance. You can't ask Claude "what changed last week" without copy-pasting between five panels.
about.body.p4: So we built GA Lite. Connect Google once, import every GA4 property, and see every site you own on one screen.
about.body.p5: Then we exposed the same data through MCP — so Claude, Cursor, and any AI client can read your analytics directly. No install, no local process, no API key to manage. One browser sign-in and the connection stays alive.
about.body.outro: Not another dashboard. Just self-hosted, read-only, AI-callable analytics that fits how you actually work.
about.hero.subtitle: How GA Lite became analytics that fits how teams actually work.
about.body.quote_1: GA4 is a great database. The dashboard just isn't the right interface.
about.body.quote_2: No install. No local process. Just a URL — sign in once and you're done.

api_docs.meta.title: API Docs · GA Lite
api_docs.meta.description: Use the GA Lite API to read Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console (GSC) and Bing Webmaster Tools data through one interface.
api_docs.title: API Docs
api_docs.subtitle: Use the GA Lite API to read Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console (GSC) and Bing Webmaster Tools data from scripts, apps or AI clients.
api_docs.sections.start.title: Quick start
api_docs.sections.start.p1: Create an API key from your account settings, then send it as a Bearer token. All API routes are read-only and return JSON.
api_docs.sections.start.items.1: Use /api/mcp when connecting Claude, Cursor or another MCP-aware client.
api_docs.sections.start.items.2: Periods support today, yesterday, 7days, 28days, 90days, 180days, 365days and custom_START_END.
api_docs.sections.auth.title: Authentication
api_docs.sections.auth.p1: API keys are created inside GA Lite. Keep them server-side and rotate them if they are exposed.
api_docs.sections.projects.title: Projects
api_docs.sections.projects.p1: Project endpoints return the sites you can access and the data sources connected to each project.
api_docs.sections.metrics.title: Site metrics
api_docs.sections.metrics.p1: Metrics endpoints read GA4 data for one project. Use force=1 only for manual refresh flows.
api_docs.sections.search.title: Search data
api_docs.sections.search.p1: Search endpoints combine Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster data. The sp parameter chooses all, gsc or bing.
api_docs.sections.funnels.title: Funnels
api_docs.sections.funnels.p1: Funnels are read-only through the public API. Create and edit funnel definitions in the dashboard.
api_docs.sections.raw.title: Raw provider proxy
api_docs.sections.raw.p1: Raw proxy endpoints are for compatibility with native GA4, GSC or Bing request shapes. Prefer curated endpoints unless you need a provider-native response.
api_docs.sections.mcp.title: MCP endpoint
api_docs.sections.mcp.p1: MCP clients use browser OAuth by default. API keys remain available as a fallback for scripts and custom clients.
